The '''92nd Interceptor Squadron''' was a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE/IN interceptor]] pilots from the 92nd Interceptor Squadron were part of a mixed squadron with [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE/D Defender]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] from the [[29th Fast Attack Squadron]] stationed aboard the [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate]] [[Mephitis (EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate)|''Mephitis'']] while it conducted tests of the [[TIE/ph "Phantom" Multi-Role Stealth Starfighter/Legends|TIE/ph phantom]] near [[Polis Massa/Legends|Polis Massa]].
